rationale: Transition logits are the hyperparameter-like pieces; given them mu (tight N(3,1), N(10,1) priors, well-identified by data) is near Gaussian. mu on the unconstrained (log) scale has small SDs (~0.1-0.3), so keeping them inner avoids nlminb scale problems. Risks: theta logits start at 0 and SDs with N=100 may be around 0.5-1 but could be larger if a state is rarely left; label switching is excluded by ordering; likelihood is nonconvex in mu so the inner mode from zero init (mu=1,2) may land in a poor mode.
